cim: AHA launches new homepage on artificial intelligence policy and advocacy
cim_eredeti: AHA launches new homepage on artificial intelligence policy and advocacy
szoveg_eredeti: The AHA Nov. 3 launched a new webpage, Artificial Intelligence Policy and Advocacy, featuring AHA policy letters, statements, fact sheets, news and other resources. The page also includes stories from hospitals and health systems that have leveraged AI to improve efficiency, support the workforce and enhance patient care. LEARN MORE
